measure_definition: The fraction of a question's gold assertions (must_include_ids plus must_include_related) the ANSWER states — narrative, claims and abstentions. deterministic_scores.coverage matches by identifier only and is blind to every gold item the catalogue publishes as text. A long gold item is matched by its words rather than byte-for-byte, because the gold composes an execution step as `step phase description` and the graph stores those as separate properties. A PROXY for the judged score, not a substitute: it tracked the Step 6 judgments closely enough to steer repair (D4 0.5471 here against 0.5405 judged) at seconds per run.
dev_deterministic_note: The 2 apparent regressions are both a 558-record CATALOGUE DUMP being removed that happened to contain the gold identifier. The replacement answers are correct and narrow.
holdout_note: Run twice, both times AFTER the fixes, as a generalisation check. Nothing was tuned against it. Model-free retrieval and composition only; NOT a judged number and must not be quoted as one.
merged_store_note: `promote_public_id` now promotes categories, views and non-ATT&CK taxonomy entries, so the merged store must be REBUILT before the merged-arm counterfactual (C-015) is re-run. Its committed figures predate this.
